title: oven thermometer
text: oven thermometer. I just got a new stove (warranty replacement) after having real trouble on the heating unit - so I really needed this thermometer to make sure we are at least close to the temp.  So far, the stove has been heating pretty darn close to perfect according to this thermometer.  I also purchased a trigger temp to have 2 separate readings.  I am really happy with this thermometer because it's so easy to read and apparently accurate.  The hook turns so you can hang it in a convenient place to read it.  It looks and feels like stainless steel.  So far, so good.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
